items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Stacked rows that open in place, so a long page of answers stays short until someone asks for one.

items.name: agent-avatar
items.title: Agent Avatar
items.description: A deterministic SVG face for an agent: the same seed always draws the same overlapping blobs, in theme colours.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An in-page message with a title, description, action and dismiss, in neutral, success, warning and error tones and four layouts.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Holds the space for media before it arrives, so the page does not jump, with a mat, an overlaid caption or an empty slot.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A face or initials that identifies a person at a glance, alone or as an overlapping group with a +N.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Small status chip in five variants; the warm mise variant is reserved for the one item that must stand out.

items.name: beam-border
items.title: Beam Border
items.description: One beam of light travelling the border of the surface the model is working on, so the eye knows where to wait.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A trail from the root to the current page, with a nav landmark, a current marker and a middle that collapses into a menu.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Press target that answers on pointer-down: a 3% dip in 100 ms, so the click feels acknowledged.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A full-size calendar for showing what is on: month grid with labels, a seven day strip, a grouped agenda or a whole year, with a keyboard grid and any locale.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Bordered surface with header, content and footer slots that reads as one region before anyone reads the text.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Slides on native scroll snapping with no library: swipe, buttons and arrow keys, as a single slide, visible neighbours, a stacked deck or a thumbnail strip.

items.name: chat-assistant
items.title: Chat Assistant
items.description: A full AI chat screen that shows the model working: steps, tool calls, streaming text and a composer that swaps Send for Stop.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Square toggle that fills and draws its check within 150 ms of the press, and announces the change through aria-checked.

items.name: clipboard
items.title: Clipboard
items.description: One-press copy with a clear result: a lone icon, a code line, a read-only field or a labelled block, and a safe way out when the browser refuses.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: One disclosure: a label that opens the detail under it, for the one thing most readers can skip.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: A saturation square, hue and opacity sliders, typed hex and presets, in a popover, inline, as presets only, or as a compact field, with a thumb that never lags behind the hand.

items.name: color-swatch
items.title: Color Swatch
items.description: Shows a colour with its name and value, alone or as a palette, with a label that stays readable on any fill and a checker under transparency.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A searchable select for long lists, single or multiple, with people rows, section headers, chips and loading built in.

items.name: dashboard-overview
items.title: Dashboard Overview
items.description: A product dashboard built around one number: a large metric with its chart, a quieter row under it, recent activity and the one thing that needs you.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A calendar with no date library: single days or ranges, limits, a full keyboard grid and any locale, as a popover, inline, a typed field or two months with a band.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal surface that dims everything else and holds focus until the user answers one question.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge for a side task, so the page you came from stays where you left it.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Compact menu of actions that opens from a button and closes on choice, with arrow-key navigation and a destructive variant.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: What a list or a search shows when it has nothing: an icon, a plain reason and the next step, centred, in a dashed slot, on a card or in one row.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: A first screen that gives people somewhere to start, with one action and three worked examples.

items.name: feature-bento
items.title: Feature Bento
items.description: An asymmetric feature grid: mixed cell sizes, live visuals built from kit effects in some cells and large type in the others.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Gives any control a label, description, error and required mark, and wires the ids and aria attributes so nobody has to remember them.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: A real drop zone and file input with type, size and count limits, clear errors and a progress list. It never touches the network: you upload and pass the state back.

items.name: floating-panel
items.title: Floating Panel
items.description: A movable window that stays on screen: drag with pointer capture, resize, minimise, close and move by keyboard, as a titled panel, tight chrome, a side dock or a tool palette.

items.name: gooey-morph
items.title: Gooey Morph
items.description: Status dots that merge into one body and split apart again like a liquid, so the eye tracks one thing changing.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A preview that appears over a link when the pointer rests on it, laid out for free content, a person, a page or a number.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text field, 36 px tall to match Button, that moves the invalid state onto its border and ring.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: One-time code entry drawn as boxes but built on one real input, so SMS autofill, paste, backspace and screen readers all work.

items.name: intelligence-glow
items.title: Intelligence Glow
items.description: A slow light around the screen edge while the assistant listens or thinks, visible from anywhere on the page.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard keys as hairline caps, physical keys, tight chips or plain text, with chords, a platform-aware modifier and a cap that dips on the real key.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Caption bound to a control: clicking it focuses the field, and it dims when the field is disabled.

items.name: landing-hero
items.title: Landing Hero
items.description: A left-aligned marketing hero with one message, two actions and a live product preview built from real components, not a screenshot.

items.name: liquid-metal
items.title: Liquid Metal
items.description: A WebGL metal surface behind a button or chip, with reflections that drift so the control reads as a real, premium material.

items.name: listbox
items.title: Listbox
items.description: A list you choose from, always open: single or multiple, type-ahead, Home and End, groups and disabled options, written to the full ARIA pattern.

items.name: login-form
items.title: Login Form
items.description: A split login screen with labels that stay visible, inline errors, a password you can reveal and a calm brand panel.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: An endless CSS-driven row that stops when someone reaches for it, and turns into a still, scrollable row for people who turned motion off.

items.name: materialize
items.title: Materialize
items.description: A surface that arrives like a material coming into focus: slightly smaller, softer, from its anchor, and leaves the same way.

items.name: motion
items.title: Motion presets
items.description: Critically damped and momentum springs, Apple's momentum projection and rubber-banding, shared by every moving Mise UI component.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Site navigation with panels on Radix: a plain bar, a mega panel of groups, a sliding pill or a sliding underline, and a panel that morphs between triggers.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: A field for amounts that clamps to its range, repeats while a button is held, reads formatted text back, and comes as chevrons, split, pill or one big number.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Moves through a long list in steady chunks, with the window of pages always the same width so controls never shift.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: A password field with a reveal button and a caps lock hint, plus a strength meter, a live checklist or a meter on the field edge.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Small floating panel anchored to the control that opened it, for a form or detail that does not need a full dialog.

items.name: pricing-table
items.title: Pricing Table
items.description: Three plans with one dominant centre, an honest yearly anchor and feature rows you can read straight across.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Shows how far a task has come, as a bar, a hairline, discrete steps or a labelled percent, and admits it when nobody knows yet.

items.name: progress-circular
items.title: Progress Circular
items.description: Progress in a small square: a ring, a hairline, a 270 degree gauge or discrete cells, with the value in the middle and an honest state when nobody knows.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: One choice from a short list with every option in view, as dots, selectable cards, joined buttons or rows, with arrow keys built in.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: A score picked with a click or the arrow keys, as stars, hearts, a joined number scale or a row of segments, with half steps and a read-only form.

items.name: reasoning-steps
items.title: Reasoning Steps
items.description: Collapsed timeline of the model's steps; the header names the current one, the body shows them all.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Two panes with a draggable divider, horizontal or vertical, with limits that stretch, a keyboard-operable separator and a double-click reset.

items.name: reveal-image
items.title: Reveal Image
items.description: An image that arrives as it is generated: blur to sharp, coarse mosaic to fine, or a left-to-right wipe, driven by a progress value.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A scroller with a styled bar that matches the theme, as a hover bar, a thin overlay, edge shadows or a snapping row.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: A short set of mutually exclusive views, always one on, as a thumb in a track, chips, an underline or square icons.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Dropdown for one choice from a list, with a placeholder, groups, a check on the chosen row and full keyboard support.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A rule between groups of content, as a hairline, a dashed break, a labelled divider or a line that fades at both ends.

items.name: settings-page
items.title: Settings Page
items.description: A settings screen in grouped rows, with a save bar that appears only when something changed and a destructive area kept well away from the rest.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Bottom sheet you can grab mid-flight: it tracks the finger 1:1, rubber-bands at the top, and lands where the release velocity was heading.

items.name: shimmer-text
items.title: Shimmer Text
items.description: A band of light passing over a status label, so “Thinking…” reads as in progress without inventing a percentage.

items.name: signup-steps
items.title: Signup Steps
items.description: A sign-up that asks one question at a time, starts with real progress on the bar and never ticks consent for anyone.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Pulsing placeholder shaped like the content that is loading, so the wait feels shorter than a spinner.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Picks a value or a range by feel, as a thin line, a thick volume track, labelled steps or a value bubble, with full keyboard control.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Says work is running when nobody knows how long it will take: a ring, three dots, eight bars or an orbit, with a pulse instead of movement for people who turned motion off.

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: Shows where someone is in a process, across a line, down a column, as a bar with a count or as numbered rows, with done, current, upcoming and error states.

items.name: streaming-text
items.title: Streaming Text
items.description: Reveals arriving text character by character at reading speed, with a caret that marks where the next word lands.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Sliding on/off control whose thumb travels 16 px in 150 ms, mirroring the physical toggle it imitates.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Real table markup with sortable headers, a sticky head, selection state, an empty row and right-aligned figures, in plain, striped, card or compact, scrolling inside itself when narrow.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Segmented control that swaps one panel for another in place, so related views share a single spot on the screen.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: A short label that can also be pressed or removed: soft tint, outline, solid or a status dot, with status tones that never borrow the accent.

items.name: tags-input
items.title: Tags Input
items.description: A field for many short values: add with Enter or comma, paste a whole list, walk tags with the arrows, with limits, validation and suggestions.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text field that starts at 64 px and grows with its content, so the answer is never hidden behind a scrollbar.

items.name: theme
items.title: Mise theme
items.description: Warm amber on cool neutrals. Friendly and alive. Complete tokens, motion included.

theme.font-display: "Geist Variable", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", system-ui, sans-serif

items.name: theme-cobalt
items.title: Cobalt theme
items.description: Saturated blue. Trustworthy, for finance and B2B. Complete tokens, motion included.

theme.font-display: "Geist Variable", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", system-ui, sans-serif

items.name: theme-ember
items.title: Ember theme
items.description: Hot rose. Bold, for consumer and creative products. Complete tokens, motion included.

theme.font-display: "Geist Variable", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", system-ui, sans-serif

items.name: theme-forest
items.title: Forest theme
items.description: Deep green. Calm, for health, money and climate. Complete tokens, motion included.

theme.font-display: "Geist Variable", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", system-ui, sans-serif

items.name: theme-ink
items.title: Ink theme
items.description: No colour at all. Serious, for tools and documents. Complete tokens, motion included.

theme.font-display: "Geist Variable", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", system-ui, sans-serif

items.name: thinking-indicator
items.title: Thinking Indicator
items.description: Three breathing dots and a live label that tell the user the model is working, and on what.

items.name: thinking-orb
items.title: Thinking Orb
items.description: A breathing sphere whose motion says idle, listening, thinking or speaking without a word of text.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A brief message about something that just happened, which waits while you read it and leaves without being asked.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed: quiet fill, darkening border, filter chip with a check, or a square icon in the accent.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A row of buttons that stay pressed, one at a time or several at once: quiet fill, joined outline, wrapping chips or square icons.

items.name: tool-call-card
items.title: Tool Call Card
items.description: Collapsible record of one tool call: name, status, duration, and the exact input and output on demand.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: One-line hint that appears on hover or focus with no delay and leaves with the pointer, for detail that does not deserve screen space.

items.name: tree-view
items.title: Tree View
items.description: A nested list written to the full ARIA tree pattern: arrow keys, type-ahead, single or multiple selection and lazy children, with guide lines, dense rows or a card per branch.

items.name: use-view-transition
items.title: useViewTransition
items.description: Five named page-transition presets on the View Transitions API, with a reduced-motion cross-fade and a plain fallback.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: cn() class merger.

items.name: voice-glow
items.title: Voice Glow
items.description: A round glow that swells with the microphone level, so the user sees the assistant is listening and how loudly it hears them.

items.name: voice-wave
items.title: Voice Wave
items.description: Bars that rise with the microphone level so the user can see they are being heard, and see when they are not.
